newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Monday amid thin trade as local investors failed to find clear direction, traders said.
Prices were 20 to 150 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 20 yen at 13,870 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 43,387 lots.

Light selling by individual investors capped the topside in early morning, traders said. "The market had no clear direction today, and most participants hesitated to trade actively," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.69-1/2 per bushel at 0740 GMT, against $2.70-3/4 at Friday's close.
The spot January of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.08-1/4 at 0740 GMT, against $7.12-3/4 at Friday's close.
